strands.name: Spelling Patterns
strands.description: Phonic knowledge and word study, from the NCERD Writing and Representing strand (ELO 9: spelling).

objectives.description: Spell Grade 1 high-frequency words and words with common letter patterns, using phonic knowledge
Use knowledge of common spelling patterns and word families to spell unfamiliar words
Spell words with common prefixes and suffixes, and use a dictionary to check spelling
Spell words with more complex letter patterns and less common homophones correctly
Use knowledge of word roots, prefixes and suffixes to spell and understand less familiar words
Spell most words correctly, including some words with irregular spelling patterns

strands.name: Punctuation
strands.description: Sentence and text punctuation, from the NCERD Writing and Representing strand (ELO 9: conventions).

objectives.description: Use a capital letter for the start of a sentence and a full stop to end it
Use capital letters, full stops, question marks and exclamation marks correctly
Use commas to separate items in a list
Use inverted commas and other punctuation to indicate direct speech
Use commas to clarify meaning and avoid ambiguity in longer sentences
Use a range of punctuation correctly, including semi-colons, colons and dashes

strands.name: Sentence Construction
strands.description: Building and varying sentences, from the NCERD Writing and Representing strand.

objectives.description: Write simple sentences that make sense, using a capital letter and a full stop
Join words and clauses using "and" to write compound sentences
Use conjunctions to join clauses and create sentences with more than one idea
Use fronted adverbials and expanded noun phrases to add detail and variety to sentences
Use relative clauses to add extra information to a sentence
Use a range of sentence structures, including active and passive voice, for effect
